title: Regression since `v14.2.0-canary.24`: `loading.tsx` triggered on first `revalidatePath()` call

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue was opened via the bug report template.

labels.name: Runtime
labels.description: Related to Node.js or Edge Runtime with Next.js.

body:
### Link to the code that reproduces this issue

https://github.com/kevinmitch14/regression-canary-24/
https://github.com/kevinmitch14/regression-v14.2.0-canary.24/ (renamed so just adding this to make sure)


### To Reproduce

1. run `next dev`
2. Navigate to `/`. Click submit. No loading.tsx triggered.
3. Navigate to `/test`. Hard refresh. Click submit. loading.tsx triggered on first click. Not triggered for subsequent.
4. Install anything below version `v14.2.0-canary.24`
5. Repeat steps
6. Loading boundary not triggered on `/test` after click (`revalidatePath()`).

### Current vs. Expected behavior

Loading.tsx should not be triggered. 
This was introduced in v14.2.0-canary.24`

### Provide environment information

```bash
  Arch: arm64

  react-dom: 19.0.0-rc-6d3110b4d9-20240531

Next.js Config:
  output: N/A
```


### Which area(s) are affected? (Select all that apply)

Not sure, Runtime

### Which stage(s) are affected? (Select all that apply)

next dev (local), next start (local), Vercel (Deployed)

### Additional context

Happens in dev, start and when deployed to vercel.
Does not happen before `v14.2.0-canary.24`
